notes.title: Nightfall will soon no longer be available
notes.content: [p]To our Nightfall community,[/p][p]We’re saddened to announce that [i]Nightfall[/i] will be removed from Steam in 90 days. This decision comes after an unexpected hardware failure that resulted in the complete loss of the project’s source code and development files. Despite extensive efforts, the data is unrecoverable, and we are unable to continue supporting or updating the game.[/p][p]This was not an easy decision. We understand the disappointment this may cause, and we want to sincerely thank everyone who supported [i]Nightfall[/i] throughout its development and release.[/p][p]If you already own [i]Nightfall[/i], it will remain in your Steam library and fully playable after it is delisted. However, the game will no longer be available for purchase or download once it is removed.[/p][p]We appreciate your understanding during this difficult moment, and thank you for being part of the [i]Nightfall[/i] journey.[/p][p]– The Nightfall Team[/p]

notes.title: Small Hotfix (May 02, 2021)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Today we are pushing some small hotfixes for the game.

[list][*]-Attempted to fix an issue where sometimes the host wouldn't load into the game correctly.
[*]-Attempted to fix some various in-game crashes.
[*]-Attempted to fix an issue where some players were occasionally stuck on a black screen on launch
[/list]

If you are still experiencing these issues (or any others) please let us know on our Discord - you can join by clicking the button in the top right hand corner of the main game menu.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Today we are releasing a small update to address some bugs and add an extra lobby setting.

[list]
[*]-Added Blood Test Success Rate option - this allows the lobby host to change the success chance of the Blood Test
[*]-Fixed an issue where settings weren't saving correctly.
[*]-Fixed an issue where the 'You were killed by...' notification displayed the wrong icon.
[*]-Fixed some issues where games were in a broken state.
[/list]

If you have any feedback or are experiencing bugs, please join us on the Discord and let us know!
https://discord.gg/t28uepVnm3

Enjoy everyone!

notes.title: Minor Post-Release Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have pushed a small hotfix for the game post-release.

-Added 'How To Play' menu to the game. This will give players a much better understanding of how the game works, what the job of each role is, and so on. This menu was already accessible from within a game but now you can see it on the main menu.

-Removed some debugging hotkeys.

Enjoy everyone! Remember, if you are struggling to find games, you can try to find players on our Discord!

notes.title: Nightfall is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are pleased to announce that Nightfall is now live and playable on Steam - slightly ahead of our planned schedule :)

Please remember that we are in Early Access, and likely will be experiencing some teething problems during the early phases of release.

If you have any bug reports or issues with the game, please consider joining our Discord @ https://discord.gg/t28uepVnm3 and report them to us directly so that we can address them as soon as possible.

Have fun~

notes.title: Join us on Discord
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very excited that Nightfall will be released and ready to play in less than 2 weeks.

With that in mind, we've created an official public Discord server for Nightfall, which you can join here:
https://discord.gg/t28uepVnm3

We may be inviting users to do some pre-release testing and even giving out some promotional cd key packs for you to play with your friends, so it'll be worth your time if you're interested in the game!
